desc:
hey, welcome to JD. you can race, crash any car you want and even recreate some infamous nascar wrecks if youd like to.
public servers are normally laggy so i recommend playing with friends in a private server.

Credits to Stunod Racing from NR2003 for most meshes and schemes in the game.

Changelog:
- Added 2012 Soft body car
- Added a bunch of backend fixes to avoid majority of exploits
- Added f3x back for private server owners

heres my group if youd like to join:
https://www.roblox.com/groups/10912446/vouthins-studio#!/about

if youd like to try an older jd version, here: https://www.roblox.com/games/14946814596/just-daytona-LEGACY

If you want the previous version, here: https://www.roblox.com/games/70475707256697/just-daytona-UNSUPPORTED-LEGACY

note: theres assets from pummu dega that the owner kindly provided.
